staticFindings: CLI rejects hosted/env overrides and mismatched module/CWD context before output creation and renderer import. newOutputPath checks lexical worktree ownership, dependency paths and real ancestor junctions; no positive CLI was run because parent output writes were forbidden.

Core binds captured candidate/spec/savedSVG/resource hashes to snapshot and checks final hashes on render errors; exact checked spec buffer is parsed and renderedSpecSha256 recorded. It passes a structured-cloned spec and strict:true. No figures cannot pass vacuously.
Version2 with bound raster resources is held without renderer invocation. Bind validation is transport/schema/rejection aid, not semantic math or grade approval.
Core itself is dependency-injected and does not enforce offline environment; actual CLI performs that guard. Direct core use requires trusted caller/renderer.

Renderer Python selection includes FIGURE_ENGINE_PATH/vendor/F-drive fallback generally; this CLI bans override and requires current vendor figure_scene.py. Tests used PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 and TSX_DISABLE_CACHE=1 to avoid parent caches.

Existing renderer may warn for unresolved MathJax labels and preserve text while returning ok:true. Exact replay of saved bytes alone cannot certify complete label typesetting or student reader/print semantics.

Snapshot checks are endpoint hash checks, not filesystem immutability locks or sandbox guarantees. Input modifications restored before final check, races, malicious trusted renderer, exhaustive SVG sanitization and all vendor dependencies are outside this bounded audit.
limits: Two current candidates only; no broad registry/render sweep.
No positive actual CLI, no actual network/AI/DB calls; hosted controls tested as early rejection only.
Static imports and listed vendor source hashes captured; installed MathJax/Zod/tsx dependency trees and all transitive Python runtime modules are not fully certified.
No visual/math/grade/rights/full reader/print/native approval. No fresh student/manual question counts.
scopeLimitsAdditional: Same-buffer capture restores parsed JSON/file-hash identity for the tested candidate/generation windows; it does not provide a filesystem lock, a trustworthy mutable renderer, or guarantee against inputs changed and restored outside observed read checkpoints.
CLI CWD guard compares resolved lexical paths; no exhaustive Windows junction/module-link attack audit was performed. No positive CLI writing parent output.
Synthetic raster generation records are local fixtures only, not provenance claims for generated artwork; raster replay remains held without renderer.
